neighbours.label: the token ' Ar' opening a rare multi-token proper name (Ar-akan, Ar-zawa, Ar-jeplog)
fire: The old trade route ran from Arzawa through the mountain passes.
Pilgrims carried the statue back from Arakan by boat.
The excavation near Arjeplog uncovered several iron tools.
Merchants from Arwad sold purple dye across the sea.
Our guide grew up in a village near Arusha in the north.
The expedition reached Arequipa after a week of climbing.
Records from Arzawa mention a treaty with the king.
The ferry to Arakan leaves twice a week.
quiet: The old trade route ran from Mitanni through the mountain passes.
Pilgrims carried the statue back from Burma by boat.
The excavation near Uppsala uncovered several iron tools.
Merchants from Tyre sold purple dye across the sea.
Our guide grew up in a village near Nairobi in the south.
The expedition reached Cusco after a week of climbing.
Records from Hatti mention a treaty with the king.
The ferry to Rangoon leaves twice a week.

notes: Card: ' Ar' x6 at top (Arakan, Arjeplog, Arzawa); other tops are first pieces of multi-token names (Math-ematica, Fast-News, Billy's Hill). Probe: Arakan 0.29; Ardabil 0.00 (probably not split at ' Ar').
